task_reconstruction.summary: Predict gold, silver, bronze, and total medals, and the 2028 ranking.
Name first-time medalists and the events that move the table.
Estimate the great-coach effect and name three countries and the sports.
Give medal-distribution advice to national Olympic committees.

contributions.summary: A Tobit-Mundlak model plus a Hurdle for countries under ten medals.
A dynamic DID with inverse-probability weights and a double robust estimator.
Former host and subsequent host as two new variables, BE and AF.
A Sport Contribution Score, then four country bands.

dependency_graph.summary: Host effect, participation, and performance enter the coach regression as covariates.
The medal regression is refit with BE and AF, and Australia moves from 45 to 66.

Event counts in 2028 and 2032 are only the host effect and international trends.
